experiment: ONNX export + parity for det7b, and a dynamic-axes defect found

export.change: load_det -> load_any_det so local-token and variant families can be exported; det_head.load_det only knew pooled archs and raised ValueError on token_stats

parity_512.verdict: PASS on real images from four domains

defect.summary: the fixed-grid local-token det head cannot be exported with working dynamic height/width
defect.why_silent: TokenStatsHead.forward_tokens validates tokens.shape[1] == 64 with a Python assert-style check that only runs while tracing, so at runtime the graph feeds 100/256/576 tokens through a head sized for 64 and returns a plausible wrong number
defect.attempts: F.interpolate(size=(8,8), mode="area") was tried because it is bit-identical in PyTorch (max|d| = 0.0 on real backbone features) and lowers to a dynamic Resize op; it produced the same 100/256/576 token counts, so the pooling op is not the cause and the change was reverted
defect.scope: det5/det6/det7 local-token family only. det1-det4 pooled heads and the seg branch are unaffected.
defect.production_impact: none today: tiling.det_score_image and tiling.iter_tiles both resize to ONNX_TILE_SIZE=512, which is the traced size

mitigation_added.change: DET_EXPORT_TILE_SIZE=512 constant and det_score_image now returns None with a stderr message when a 2-output model is called with a tile_size other than the exported size
mitigation_added.rationale: a wrong det score is worse than no det score, so refuse rather than guess
mitigation_added.tested: tile_size 512 returns a score, 640 and 1024 return None, det2b unaffected

not_done: seg-metric regression on the exported graph was not run because the det branch defect made multi-resolution parity fail; it should be run at 512 only if promotion proceeds
no shadow rollout, no ONNX_MODEL_PATH change, no commit
